ALTER PROCEDURE DW.SP_DimRiskRatingType
AS
BEGIN

WITH DIMRISKRATINGTYPE AS 
(
SELECT
BRR.RISKRATINGTYPEID AS RiskRatingTypeID
,BRR.RiskRatingTypeName AS RiskRatingTypeName
,NULL AS RiskRatingTypeDescription
,DDB.BANKSK AS BankSK
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,BRR.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm

FROM BNKM.RiskRatingType BRR
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMBANK DDB ON BRR.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BANKID
WHERE BRR.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'CRM'

UNION ALL

SELECT
'TU Score' AS RiskRatingTypeID
,'TU Score' AS RiskRatingTypeName
,NULL AS RiskRatingTypeDescription
,DDB.BANKSK AS BankSK
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm

FROM DW.DIMBANK DDB
WHERE DDB.BANKid = 'CBC01'

UNION ALL

SELECT
'ECRAF' AS RiskRatingTypeID
,'ECRAF' AS RiskRatingTypeName
,NULL AS RiskRatingTypeDescription
,DDB.BANKSK AS BankSK
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm

FROM DW.DimBank DDB
WHERE DDB.BANKid = 'CBC11'
),

RISKRATINGTYPE_SK
AS(
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(RiskRatingTypeSK),0) RN FROM DW.DIMRISKRATINGTYPE
)
,
TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE
AS 
(
SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM RISKRATINGTYPE_SK) AS RiskRatingTypeSK
,RiskRatingTypeID
,RiskRatingTypeName
,RiskRatingTypeDescription
,BankSK
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM DIMRISKRATINGTYPE
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE FROM TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE;

WITH
TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     RiskRatingTypeID
    ,RiskRatingTypeName
    ,RiskRatingTypeDescription
    ,BankSK
    )) HASHROW, RiskRatingTypeID,BankSK 
    FROM #TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE 
)
,
TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     RiskRatingTypeID
    ,RiskRatingTypeName
    ,RiskRatingTypeDescription
    ,BankSK
    )) HASHROW, RiskRatingTypeID,BankSK 
    FROM DW.DimRiskRatingType WHERE ValidEndDate = '9999-12-31'
)
,
TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.RiskRatingTypeID,TGT.RiskRatingTypeID) AS RiskRatingTypeID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	    WHEN TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.RiskRatingTypeID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.RiskRatingTypeID = TGT.RiskRatingTypeID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.RiskRatingTypeID IS NULL AND TGT.BANKSK IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE_DELTA FROM TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE_DELTA;

--UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = GETDATE()

FROM DW.DimRiskRatingType TGT
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.RiskRatingTypeID = TGT.RiskRatingTypeID  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE SRC ON SRC.RiskRatingTypeID = TGT.RiskRatingTypeID AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
WHERE TGT.ValidEndDate = '9999-12-31';


INSERT INTO  DW.DimRiskRatingType(
RiskRatingTypeSK
,RiskRatingTypeID
,RiskRatingTypeName
,RiskRatingTypeDescription
,BankSK
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
RiskRatingTypeSK
,SRC.RiskRatingTypeID
,RiskRatingTypeName
,RiskRatingTypeDescription
,SRC.BankSK
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE SRC
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.RiskRatingTypeID = SRC.RiskRatingTypeID  AND DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

END
